note: Confirmation codes must be heard letter by letter. v1 is the raw code, v2 is the spaced form we ship for Coda, v3 is the spell() form we ship for Mist models.
variants: Your confirmation code is F D, 7 Q 2 K.

note: Times: digits with AM/PM vs words. We ship the digit form because it stays short and Rime's text normalization reads it correctly.
variants: On Thursday afternoon I have 1 PM, 3 PM and 4 PM.
On Thursday afternoon I have one, three and four in the afternoon.

note: Lead-in before a slow tool call. A short sentence with a period gets to first audio faster than a clause ending in an ellipsis.
Recovery after an empty interruption. The comma pause before resuming sounds more natural than running straight on.
variants: Sorry, as I was saying. On Thursday afternoon I have 4 PM.
Sorry as I was saying on Thursday afternoon I have 4 PM.

note: Surfacing a booking the caller never heard confirmed. Leading with 'Quick note' signals a correction without sounding alarmed.
variants: Quick note, I did book Tuesday at 1 PM, code F D, Q Z 2 J.
I booked Tuesday at 1 PM, F D Q Z 2 J.
